label: Podcast / Interview
description: Conversation-first multicam cuts; preserve authentic exchange and natural phrasing.
intent: Clarify a conversation without turning it into a hyperactive montage.
opening: Begin with a truthful exchange that signals the value of the conversation.
editing: Cut on speaker/reaction/subject shift; preserve hesitations that carry meaning.
typography: Speaker IDs and occasional quote pull-outs; no constant kinetic distraction.
sound: Match and clean speech across angles; silence can be valuable.
critique: Does it sound and feel like a real exchange?

creative_contrast.when: A new idea, action or visual fact arrives
The viewer needs to read, understand or feel something
